description: The 'mcp_agent_tools' dataset provides a comprehensive overview of various agent tools used within Dataiku DSS projects. Each entry in the dataset represents a unique agent tool, identified by a project key and an agent tool ID. The dataset includes detailed information about each tool, such as its name, type, and a description tailored for large language models (LLMs). Additionally, it records metadata about the creation and modification of the tools, including timestamps and user information. The dataset also contains JSON objects detailing the parameters of each tool, which can include environment settings and execution commands. This dataset is particularly useful for managing and analyzing the deployment and configuration of agent tools in data science projects, facilitating better understanding and optimization of tool usage. It can be used by data scientists and project managers to track tool versions, understand tool functionalities, and ensure that the tools are configured correctly for their intended purposes. The inclusion of URLs and tags further aids in categorizing and accessing these tools efficiently.
shortDesc: Dataset of agent tools in Dataiku DSS projects.
